title: Director, Quality Systems, Development Quality Biologics
text:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264366 **Date posted** 19/11/2026

 

**WHY JOIN US?**

At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

Join us on this exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and collaboration, and we are always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. As part of our team, you'll contribute to groundbreaking advancements that will shape a healthier future for people everywhere. Be a catalyst for change at AstraZeneca, where your work will have a real impact on improving people's lives.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.**This is a hybrid role located in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Gaithersburg or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.****About the Role**

The Director, Quality Systems is a senior leader within Development Quality Biologics (DQB), accountable for strategy, governance, performance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) supporting Biologics Development.

The role provides leadership and oversight for critical Quality Systems processes, including Deviation and CAPA Management, Change Control, Quality Risk Management, Inspection Management, Documentation Management, Quality Management Review, and GxP Training and Learning. The Director also leads Business Process Management (BPM) within DQB, ensuring business and quality processes are effectively owned, defined, governed, measured, and continuously improved.

The Director leads a team of up to 12 employees and partners broadly across DQB, Biopharmaceutical Development (BPD), Development Quality, Global Quality, and other functions to deliver a compliant, efficient, risk-based, and future-ready QMS.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the DQB Quality Management System, providing strategy, governance, and oversight to ensure Quality Systems are compliant, effective, risk-based, phase-appropriate, and fit for purpose.

* Provide leadership for core Quality Systems processes, including deviations and CAPAs, change control, quality risk management, inspection management and readiness, documentation management, Quality Management Review, GxP training, and associated metrics and trending. Champion excellence in fundamental Quality processes like root cause analysis and effective CAPA development, risk mitigation, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.

* Lead Business Process Management within DQB, establishing clear process ownership, governance, performance measures, and improvement mechanisms. Drive simplification, standardization, and elimination of non-value-added activities while maintaining appropriate compliance and control.

* Drive QMS performance and continuous improvement through meaningful metrics, trending, management review, risk identification, and data-driven insights. Translate QMS performance into clear priorities and actions for DQB and BPD leadership.

* Ensure sustainable inspection readiness, including effective preparation, execution, response, and follow-up for regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring learnings are incorporated into Quality System improvements.

* Lead and develop a team of up to 12 employees, building capability in Quality Systems, process ownership, risk-based decision-making, data and digital fluency, continuous improvement, and critical thinking.

**Shaping the QMS of the Future**

The Director will play a key role in evolving the DQB QMS to support the future needs of the Biologics’ development portfolio and AZ's 2030 Vision. The role will champion a phase-appropriate, risk-based and digitally enabled QMS that is fit for purpose, reduces unnecessary complexity, enables innovation, and maintains strong regulatory compliance and patient-focused quality.

The Director role will lead the responsible adoption of AI, advanced analytics, automation, digital workflows, and other emerging technologies to simplify processes, reduce manual work, improve knowledge access, identify quality signals earlier, and strengthen data-driven decision-making. The role will help advance the QMS from primarily retrospective management of quality events toward a more proactive and predictive model, while ensuring appropriate human accountability, transparency, data integrity, traceability, and GxP controls.

**Measures of Success**

**Success in the role will be demonstrated through:**

* A compliant, effective, phase-appropriate, and fit-for-purpose QMS that enables delivery of the AZ portfolio.

* Strong QMS health, including effective management of deviations, CAPAs, changes, risks, training, documentation, and inspection readiness.

* Mature Business Process Management with clear accountability and measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, and simplicity.

* A Quality Management Review with processes and metrics that provide actionable insights, identify emerging risks, and enable timely leadership decisions.

* Increased and appropriately governed use of data, digital solutions, automation, and AI to improve QMS performance and reduce administrative burden.

* A capable, engaged team prepared to lead and support the QMS of the future.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience within Quality in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry, including significant people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading a sizeable (10+) Quality team/function and delivering measurable improvements.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including deviations/CAPA, change control, Quality Risk Management, documentation, training, and inspection readiness.
* Strong understanding of GxP requirements, regulatory expectations, and SOP-driven environments, with experience driving compliance and sustainable Quality practices.
* Experience using Quality metrics, trending, risk indicators, and management review to identify priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and significant process or organizational change, including management of resources, stakeholders, vendors, and budgets.
* Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to partner across Quality, Development, and senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within biologics, Development Quality, or pharmaceutical development.
* Experience managing managers or leading leaders within a Quality organization.
* Experience with Business Process Management, Operational Excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement.
* Experience leading QMS transformation, harmonization, or process simplification.
* Experience with digital Quality systems, automation, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled Quality solutions in a regulated environment.
* Experience with non-GMP biopharmaceutical work and its phase-appropriate requirements for compliance.

**SO, WHAT’S NEXT?**

To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them.

**Are you interested in working at AZ, apply today!**

AstraZeneca is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion and providing a workplace that is free from discrimination. AstraZeneca is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Such accommodation is available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment, assessment and selection process and may be requested by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com.
